newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ISMA elects two new board members at AGM.
newsitem.headline: ISMA elects two new board members at AGM.

text.p: The International Securities Market Association (ISMA) elected two new board members at its annual general meeting on Thursday.

Philippe Musette, director and head of institutional bond sales at Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole in Paris, and Claudio Pisoni, head of capital markets and fixed income trading at Banca del Gottardo in Switzerland, were elected as new members.
The ISMA board has 16 members, 15 of whom are elected by member firms. The board decides on major matters of policy and approves any changes and additions to ISMA's rules and recommendations.
ISMA is the self-regulatory industry body and trade association for the international securities market. It has 820 members in 51 countries.

Three other board members were re-elected at Thursday's AGM -- Jose Manuel Hernandez Beneyto, head of group treasury and capital markets at Banco Santander in Madrid, Atilla Ilkson, senior counsel at Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith in New
York, and Rijnhard van Tets, member of the managing board at ABN AMRO Bank in Amsterdam. Van Tets is also chairman of the ISMA board.
